svg.title: Z-Algorithm: Concatenation P + $ + T and [L, R] Z-Box Window Mechanics
svg.desc: Animated diagram of the Z-algorithm on S = ABA$ABABABA showing the active [L, R] Z-box window, O(1) mirror copying when Z[k] < R - i + 1, extension beyond R when Z[k] >= R - i + 1, and exact pattern occurrences where Z[i] == |P|.
svg.text: Z-Algorithm · Concatenation S = P + "$" + T & Active [L, R] Z-Box
Z[i] = LCP(S, S[i..]); mirror k = i - L avoids redundant comparisons inside [L, R] and pushes R monotonically in O(|S|)
Hits in T: index 4-3-1 = 0 ("ABA"), index 6-3-1 = 2 ("ABA"), index 8-3-1 = 4 ("ABA")

g.text: At i = 4, R = 2 so i > R.
